_comment: Deterministic binding KAT for pqkem.DeriveFromEd25519Seed (docs/wire-introduction-v2.md option F; research.md R4 extended to the long-term ML-KEM-768 half of a hybrid identity). Re-running DeriveFromEd25519Seed on the recorded Ed25519 seed MUST produce an ML-KEM-768 public/private keypair whose canonical packed bytes hash to the SHA-256 values recorded here. If any of these values change after a CIRCL upgrade, the upgrade is wire-incompatible and must be treated as a hybrid-identity break across the deployment.
